purpose: One frozen exploratory check of whether a joint-only clipping boundary mass predicts joint classification failure better than prespecified simpler information. Not independent validation or an augmentation training study.
pre_execution_review_amendment: Before any photo-model execution, independent review required predicted total joint saturation and direct forward simulation as stronger comparisons. S is not necessarily zero: eligibility requires single predictions correct, not their pixels unsaturated. No observed new outcomes were used for this amendment.
data: All and only the 64 previously designated custom training photos in stage-validity-pilot-20261021/protocol.json train_rows; each was already used in model fitting and research development.
model_selection: Both final-step checkpoints from the one recovered recipe, fixed before this photo check; no best checkpoint or new fitting.
preprocessing: PIL RGB, torchvision bilinear resize short edge256 and center crop224, as in the original fitting; decode to float32/255. Gains and clipping applied in encoded RGB, then the fixed ImageNet normalization. No inverse-ISP or actual RAW claim.
transform_definition: First gain multiplies all channels; second gain multiplies red only; clamp[0,1] after each. No intermediate 8bit quantization. The gains and order are fixed from the prior mathematical example.

predictions_available_before_joint_evalu.B_joint_only_red_boundary_mass: mean_p(25/49 <= source_R[p] < 5/7); no observed joint predictions or labels used in this score
predictions_available_before_joint_evalu.S_single_red_saturation: max over two singles of fraction of red pixels reaching the white threshold
predictions_available_before_joint_evalu.M_single_margin_risk: negative minimum true-label logit margin among the two singles; on eligible samples both margins are positive
predictions_available_before_joint_evalu.D_direct_reconstructed_joint_margin: Negative true-label margin after forwarding clip(I10*I01/I00) through the same fixed model. This is an expected tautological ceiling under an exact software forward model, not independent evidence or an original diagnostic.

primary_evaluation.eligible: Same photo is classified correctly in source and both singles, per fixed model
primary_evaluation.event: That photo is misclassified in joint
primary_evaluation.metric: Tie-correct pairwise AUROC for each prespecified score, separately for each fixed model. Higher score predicts event. No fitted decision threshold, classifier or combined score.
primary_evaluation.screen_for_event_count: At least5 event and5 non-event photos per model is a minimal usability screen only, not a claim of statistical power or significance. If either class is missing AUC is undefined; with fewer than5 it is descriptive only.
primary_evaluation.weak_directional_hypothesis: B exceeds S, M and T in AUROC in both fixed models. The direct-query D comparator is an expected ceiling and is reported separately. Failure gives no support to this unweighted boundary-mass diagnostic on this development setting; it does not refute every clipping mechanism or causal model. Parallel AUROCs alone do not establish independent information conditional on margin.
primary_evaluation.stop: One execution, no extra gains, photos, metrics, models or repeated holdout selection after viewing results. Insufficient events mean inconclusive, not useful or useless proven.

prohibitions: retrying blocked paper or dataset URLs
nearest_prior_boundary: Semantify-NN CVPR2020 already models two-parameter brightness/contrast plus clipping and verifies classifier margins. Existence of a joint clipping failure boundary is a teaching example, not a new result. This check only asks if a cheap boundary-mass diagnostic has useful incremental predictive signal.
